facts.fact: ITWeb reports SARS had auto-assessed more than 6.9 million returns by 30 September 2026 and improved its eFiling platform for the 2026 filing season, with taxpayers able to meet obligations on digital platforms without visiting a branch.

SARS auto-assessed more than 6.9 million tax returns through its eFiling and assessment systems by 30 September 2026, 20% more than a year earlier, and paid R33 billion in refunds to 3.1 million taxpayers.
